name: Foresteria
source:
Visual Novel game about the mythical forest which is dying and It's our job as an arborist to save them .. but trees are not the only thing that you can find in this forest. Can you uncover the secret of this forest?  Will you be able to save this forest in time? 

[From [url=https://lilizzii.itch.io/foresteria]Itch.io[/url]]
